note: Exclusions for the coin list, written down before any data is fetched. By rule only: stablecoins, wrapped / liquid-staking tokens, gold-backed tokens, leveraged tokens, tokenized stocks, real-world-asset tokens. Coinbase's own fx_stablecoin flag is also used automatically. A symbol not listed here is included. Adding a symbol after results are seen is a logged variant. Leveraged tokens: Coinbase lists none, so the list is empty; a name pattern was removed because it wrongly matched real coins such as JUP. Every exclusion and its reason is written to fetch-log.txt.
